expectations.note: After clearing preferences and restarting, the Dot hero showed only the pulsing dot with no artist/title overlay.
The show-song-info option was enabled and a restart left the overlay visible, confirming persistence across restart.
Turning the option off and restarting left the Dot hero without the overlay, confirming the disabled state persists.
The genuine 100% long-metadata screenshot shows the pulsing dot covering the artist/title text, so the overlay overlaps the dot.
At 150% the long artist and title still run through the centered pulsing dot, visibly failing the hardening requirement.
The candidate submitted no normal-scale screenshot; its write-up explicitly says actual screenshot files were not provided, and the judge capture shows overlap rather than supporting the claim.
The candidate submitted no maximum-scale screenshot; the judge's 150% capture instead visibly shows overlap with the dot.
Structural reads at 100% and 150% show non-empty hero artist/title text with non-zero geometry; the max read reports 45px and 22.5px text sizes.
Short fixture metadata rendered at both scales, but the artist text was also visibly covered by the pulsing dot, so the common case is not clean.
After exercising option toggles, both text scales, and long/short tracks, the app remained live and the final runtime capture reported zero overflow reports.
